[P3] Normalize named classes consistently with checkpointed types

Java permits `$` inside a declared class name. For a named exception such as `Payment$Error`, this branch returns `Payment$Error`, whereas its checkpointed binary name passes through `simpleTypeName` and becomes `Error`. Consequently, the execution error and operation snapshot can report different names for the same failure, defeating the new identity guarantee. Apply the same binary-name normalization to both paths and add a regression test using a named exception containing `$`.
